name: The Ritz Carlton Kapalua
insider_take: Perched on Maui's pristine northwest coast, this oceanfront sanctuary sits on ancient Hawaiian burial grounds that have been respectfully preserved, creating a deeply spiritual connection to the island's sacred heritage.
whats_special: The resort overlooks the legendary Honolua Bay, one of Hawaii's most revered surf breaks and a Marine Life Conservation District teeming with tropical fish and Hawaiian green sea turtles. The property features the only three-tier infinity pool system in Hawaii, cascading down toward the Pacific Ocean.
pro_tip: Book snorkeling at Honolua Bay during winter months (December-April) when the waters are calmest and visibility reaches up to 150 feet—it's consistently ranked among the world's top 10 snorkeling spots.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Aloha Friday tradition featuring authentic Hawaiian cultural performances and the nearby Kapalua Coastal Trail, a 1.76-mile clifftop walk offering spectacular whale watching during humpback season (January-March).
pros: Stunning oceanfront location on Kapalua Bay with pristine beach access
World-class spa and wellness facilities with traditional Hawaiian treatments
Championship golf courses including Kapalua Plantation Course
Exceptional dining experiences with farm-to-table Hawaiian cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Remote location requires travel time to reach other Maui attractions
